problem_statement: DNS name unpacking does not handle nested compression pointers (RFC 1035 section 4.1.4) or multi-question queries correctly. When a domain name uses a pointer whose target label is itself followed by another pointer, only the first level of pointer is followed properly and the recorded end-of-label position is set incorrectly, so names that rely on nested compression are mis-parsed. Likewise, parsing more than one question in a query does not advance the query position relative to the current question, so questions after the first are mis-parsed. Unpacking such a name should return the full domain name and report the position just past the first pointer entry, and each question of a multi-question query should be parsed from the end of the previous one.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/dns_resolve -s tests/net/lib/dns_resolve/net.dns.resolve -s net.dns.resolve -O twister-out --no-clean -W
